issue.title: test_agents_pane_mounts_activates_and_loads flakes under the full parallel lane, including on a clean tree

task_type_fields.evidence:
Promoted by `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` as a reproducible flake over the durable host record store, on 4 gate-eligible (<=5-failure) full-run records from two independent workspaces on 2026-08-25:

- 20260825T151728Z-9fb3a1805e3c (dirty tree, 5 failures)
- 20260825T152011Z-1a96ea92bf4d (CLEAN tree, 2 failures)
- 20260825T152725Z-9fb3a1805e3c (dirty tree, 3 failures)
- 20260825T153004Z-9fb3a1805e3c (dirty tree, 1 failure)

The clean-tree record is the important one: it rules out uncommitted-source breakage and points at a genuine race rather than a dirty-tree artifact.

PASSES SERIALLY on master f56cf4333: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/ace/tui/test_agents_pane_mount.py::test_agents_pane_mounts_activates_and_loads` gives `1 passed in 8.39s`. It also passed in the full 37073-node check-full run driven from this workspace (monitor hxz0b4zxzgcw, 1h02m), so it does not reproduce on every parallel run.

Reported by epic sase-tt's land agent (sase-tt.land) while triaging the flake gate before closing sase-tt. Not caused by that epic: sase-tt touched no ACE mount path, and every record above predates its land diff.

payload.entry:
LIKELY FIXED ON MASTER e8de34fe0 (sase-tj.10 land agent, 2026-08-26). Phase sase-tj.10.3 rewrote this node's waits: test_agents_pane_mounts_activates_and_loads previously did 'await page.pause()' and then asserted pane.artifacts_active/first_activation_count, and waited only for 'pane_state() is not LOADING'. page.pause() yields to the event loop but does not wait for the off-thread catalog build, which is the race every record in this bead captured. e8de34fe0 replaced both with explicit page.wait_for(..., timeout=LOAD_TOLERANT_TIMEOUT) on the exact conditions asserted (pane mounted+activated+first_activation_count==1, then snapshot is not None and pane_state() in {RESULTS, EMPTY}).

EVIDENCE at HEAD e8de34fe0, workspace sase_15: 'just test-contention -- tests/ace/tui/test_agents_pane_mount.py' (26 workers pinned to 2 CPUs, 3 repeats, 159.4s total) reports 'contention tally: 0 node(s) failed across 3 repeat(s); red repeats: none'. Every gate-eligible record in this bead's description predates that commit (all 2026-08-25; e8de34fe0 landed 2026-08-26T10:37Z).

Not a +1 and not a close: recording the fix so triage can decide. Suggested next step is one more full-lane observation before closing.

payload.description: Both are ACE TUI agents-pane tests that fail only under the parallel lane and pass in isolation; likely the same mount/settle race rather than two independent defects.
